comments.body: Cover image was incorrect @sepo-agent besides implementing this can you also file an issue to get the cover image fixed in the Agent / Ingest Episode action? Here is the correct cover image this time:

I have the context I need. Here's my reply:

---

Thanks — I've got the corrected cover image from your comment. Note this is an answer-only route, so I can't implement the episode or open the fix issue directly here; I'll lay out the diagnosis and the exact commands to trigger both.

**Why the cover was wrong**

The ingest workflow pulls the cover straight from each RSS `<item>`'s `itunes:image href` — see [`episode-ingest.ts:96`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L96), which flows into the issue body at [`episode-ingest.ts:287`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L287). The URL it filed for ep 7 was:

```
https://d3t3ozftmdmh3i.cloudfront.net/staging/podcast_uploaded_nologo/45156119/45156119-1768982214898-0968140041ca2.jpg
```

That's a `staging/podcast_uploaded_nologo` asset — i.e. a pre-publish/no-logo staging image the feed served for that item, not the final episode artwork. So the extractor is doing what it's told; the per-item `itunes:image` in the feed just isn't reliable as the source of truth for final cover art.

**Next steps (send whichever you want Sepo to run)**

1. Release ep 7 with the correct art — the image is already attached in your comment above, so:
   - `@sepo-agent /implement` on this issue (#92). The implementer will read your corrected cover from the thread and save it to `quartz/static/covers/EP07-cover.png`.

2. Track the ingest bug. I can't open the issue from here, but you can file one and hand it to the agent in one shot. Suggested title/body:

   > **Title:** Episode-ingest picks up wrong (staging/no-logo) cover art
   >
   > **Body:** The episode-ingest action reads the cover from each RSS item's `itunes:image href` ([`episode-ingest.ts:96`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.agent/src/episode-ingest.ts#L96)). For ep 7 this resolved to a `staging/podcast_uploaded_nologo/...` asset instead of the final artwork, so the filed issue carried the wrong cover. Fix options to evaluate: prefer the channel-level `itunes:image` when an item's image points at a `staging`/`nologo` path, validate/skip staging URLs, or flag low-confidence covers in the issue body so a human confirms before implement. `@sepo-agent /implement`

If you'd rather not open a separate issue, reply here and I can outline the fix in more detail so it can be folded into the ep 7 implement run.
